title: Close temporary production-domain placeholders
rationale: Wildcard origins and temporary endpoint placeholders are acceptable only while the production domain remains genuinely undecided.

closes_at.description: The project owner confirms the production domain.

blocks.description: Replace temporary origin and endpoint configuration
Update deployment instructions for the confirmed domain

unsafe_after_close: A wildcard or placeholder remains a security and deployment defect after the production domain is known.
verification_boundary: Changing every declared path does not prove production deployment, browser behavior, endpoint reachability, or complete security review.
